New record in this file (not in the ledger before). Fairlead Structures is a division, not a separate yard; of Fairlead's sites only 99 Jefferson Ave, Newport News is described with heavy fabrication, modular work and a covered platen. The Portsmouth sites are HQ/admin (500 Crawford St), electrical panel outfitting, fabrication and machining (650 Chautauqua Ave), and outfitting, small-boat work and blast/paint (3128 Victory Blvd); no source ties hull-structure welding to a Portsmouth address.

Chattanooga is Serodino's corporate office (100 Hamm Road); the company site lists its only shipyard at 445 Hales Bar Rd, Guild TN, already p-serodino-guild-tn. News 'built by Serodino Inc in Chattanooga' refers to the company's home city.
